tagline: Traditional Cut-Throat Shaves • Master Barbering • Heritage Terrace
addressLine: 182 St Georges Terrace (Ground Floor, Heritage Arcade)
businessDescription: Established to preserve the noble traditions of classic gentlemens grooming in Western Australia. We offer hot lather straight-razor shaves, single-malt whiskey hospitality, handcrafted timber furnishings, and time-honoured scissor techniques passed down through generations of master barbers.

seo.title: St. George Barber Guild | Traditional Cut-Throat Shaves | Perth
